paper: Dynamics and activation of membrane-bound B cell receptor assembly
trajectory_access: Paper Data availability: simulation trajectories generated during study available upon request from corresponding author Dr. Gnanakaran; no public trajectory repository linked.
coordinate_access: No dedicated public initial-coordinate archive was found in paper data availability or linked repositories. Supplementary ZIP download failed via Springer SSL and PMC CAPTCHA; its full inventory was not confirmed, so coordinates cannot be declared absent from all supplements.
model_identity: 7XQ8 Fc/TM/Ig-alpha/Ig-beta used, VRC01 Fab replaced by VRC-CH31 Fab via SWISS-MODEL. Antigen model based on 6NNJ and remodeled/docked. Not sequence/coordinate-identical to existing 7XQ8 prediction CSV.
sampling: Paper reports five independent 500 ns all-atom production replicas for each unbound/antigen-bound CH31 BCR system; five 5 us coarse-grained replicas per system for lipid analysis.
missing_intracellular_regions: Paper Methods: intracellular loops of Ig-alpha/Ig-beta not modeled by SWISS-MODEL; authors retained that model rather than AlphaFold alternatives entering membrane. Cannot validate actual ITAM-loop dynamics/exposure from absent residues.
glycosylation: Paper explicitly did not model glycosylation of CH31 BCR or antigen.
membrane: Complex lipid bilayer with POPC, POPE, PSM, CER3, DAGL, cholesterol; absent from FlexPPI protein-only input. Membrane-context mismatch remains even if protein coordinates become available.
feasibility_now: Without author-provided matched input structures and all-atom trajectories, existing VRC01 7XQ8 output is not an exact-input apo/holo MD validation. Published figure source numbers might support bounded descriptive checks, but cannot substitute for recomputing chain-fitted RMSF and Hchi under FlexPPI label protocol.
actions: Read-only source audit; no emails, no new MD, no model inference, no large trajectory download.
